title: Constraining bulk-to-boundary correlators under Poincaré symmetry
summary: It is well known that a general two-point function cannot be uniquely determined by Poincaré symmetry. In this paper, we show that bulk-to-boundary correlators are highly constrained after imposing suitable fall-off conditions near future/past null infinity. More precisely, scalar bulk-to-boundary correlators are fixed to a unique form up to a normalization constant, whereas fermionic bulk-to-boundary correlators are fixed to a linear superposition of scalar and fermionic branches.
